question: limits[].kind has no term for an address count (the Webshare free plan's 10 addresses per account) or for blocked outbound ports (25, 110, 465 and 587). Should the vocabulary gain a term such as address-count?
why: Both constraints are recorded in limits_note of ip-proxy/webshare-free-plan because no kind fits; an address count is the unit of purchase across the ip-proxy topic.
